visual.nota: Energy flows one way and leaves as heat

turnos.t: In any energy transformation some energy is dispersed as unusable heat, so transformations are never 100 per cent efficient and entropy increases. That's why there is less energy at each trophic level and food chains are short.

Photosynthesis: six CO₂ plus six water plus light gives glucose and six oxygen. Respiration is the reverse, releasing energy, much of it as heat. And a trophic level is the position of an organism in a food chain, counted by energy transfers from the producers.
